changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 2b, item 3: enable exactOptionalPropertyTypes. CodexProcessOptions.binPath and HandshakeOptions.timeoutMs (both published: binPath from index.ts's CodexProcessOptions, timeoutMs from performInitializeHandshake's exported HandshakeOptions parameter type) now type as string | undefined and number | undefined so a caller can construct the field with an explicit undefined value, not only omit it. Non-breaking widening; no runtime change.
